facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

assets.label: hydrocarbon transfer pumps
assets.service: hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support

control_failures.control_label: secondary containment by bund and drainage
emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during commissioning of replacement equipment on P-4105

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4105 and TT-4105 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels on P-4105 and TT-4105 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on P-4105 and TT-4105 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4105 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the secondary containment by bund and drainage was never verified as effective. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 6 May 2011 an incident occurred on P-4105 and TT-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
